permission.heading: Allow access to your files
permission.explanation:
To keep your notes in a folder you can open from the Files app, back up, and sync with other apps, FUTO Notes needs Android’s “All files access” permission.

On the next screen, turn on “Allow access to manage all files”.
permission.privacy: FUTO Notes only ever touches its own notes folder. Your notes never leave your device unless you set up sync.
permission.denied: FUTO Notes needs “All files access” to use a shared folder.
permission.unsupported: Device storage requires Android 11 or newer.
